newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan plans no major revision in WTO telecom offer.
newsitem.headline: Japan plans no major revision in WTO telecom offer.

text.p: Japan does not plan any major revisions to its offer to liberalise its telecommunications market ahead of a February 15 World Trade Organisation deadline, a Japanese official said on Wednesday.

The official of the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry told reporters that there will be no revision to Japan's offer to lift restrictions on foreign ownership in Japan's telecommunications carriers.
"But there will be a minor technical revision to an offer regarding new interconnection rules," he said.
Japan has told the WTO that it will come up with new interconnection rules aimed at requiring Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to give rival phone firms fair acccess to its networks.

The WTO has set the new deadline to reach a global telecoms accord after having failed to meet a deadline last April. The United States has said offers from emerging economies were not good enough for it to open its domestic market to foreign operators.
"We do not think Japan's offer will be an obstacle for the WTO to reach an agreement," the Japanese official said.
